whatThisIs: GA4 userEngagementDuration divided by screenPageViews, per page. Engagement time is what Google counts as engaged, not wall-clock time with the tab open; a hidden tab is not counted. Treat it as a lower bound on reading time.
whatThisIsNot: Not a count of seconds a person read. Not comparable across sites with different tagging. Pages with fewer than 5 opens are kept in the rows but must not be quoted as an average.
